## Load Libraries

library(ape)

library(ggnewscale)
library(dplyr)
library(tidytree)
library(ggstar)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)

library(beastio)
library(treeio)
library(rBt)
```

## Import Tree Data
```{r import-tree}
thorneyBeastTree <- read.annot.beast("/Users/akanteh/Documents/backup11:08:2022/phylodynamic_newAnalysis/cluster/gambianSamples/DatasetB/NewDataAnalysis/removingDuplicates/median_treeDTA_output/GambaGlobalCombinedsubsamplesMCC_median.tree")
```

## Import Metadata
```{r import-metadata}
nexcladeDatasetA <- read.csv("~/Documents/backup11:08:2022/phylodynamic_newAnalysis/cluster/gambianSamples/DatasetA/nextcladeDatasetA.csv")
nexcladeDatasetA <- nexcladeDatasetA %>% 
  dplyr::select(seqName, Nextclade_pango) %>% 
  mutate(variant = Nextclade_pango)
```

## Define Variant Categories
```{r categorize-variants}
delta_variants <- c("AY.34.1", "B.1.617.2", "AY.34", "AY.46", "AY.34.1.1", "AY.42", "AY.22", "AY.75", "AY.5", "AY.4", "AY.43", "AY.36", "AY.133", "AY.122")
omicron_variants <- c("BA.1.1", "BA.1", "BA.1.17.2", "BA.1.17", "BA.1.1.14", "BA.1.15", "BA.1.18")
others <- c("B.1.1.359", "B", "B.1.36.1", "B.1.609", "B.1.1.368", "A", "B.1.177", "B.1.1.294", "R.1", "B.1.214.2", "B.1.1.10", "B.1.619", "B.1.1.487", "B.6", "B.1.1.101")

nexcladeDatasetA <- nexcladeDatasetA %>%
  mutate(variant = case_when(
    variant %in% delta_variants ~ "Delta Variant",
    variant %in% omicron_variants ~ "Omicron Variant",
    variant == "B.1.1.7" ~ "Alpha Variant",
    variant == "B.1.525" ~ "Eta Variant",
    variant %in% others ~ "Others",
    TRUE ~ variant
  ))
```

## Visualizing the Phylogenetic Tree
```{r plot-tree}
p <- ggtree(thorneyBeastTree, 
            mrsd = "2022-03-31",
            as.Date = TRUE,
            color = "gray50",
            size = 0.5,
            ladderize = TRUE) +
  theme_tree2()

p1 <- p %<+% nexcladeDatasetA +
  geom_tree(aes(color = variant), size = 1.0, alpha = 0.8) +  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("#51a0e9", "#DF11BD", "#0A098F", "#FFC000", "#75FF33", "#b151e9", "#8F098B", "#29dde0", "#E97451", "#CA11DF", "#964B00", "red", "#FF0000"), 
    na.value = "NA") +
  theme(
    plot.margin = unit(c(0, 2, 0.5, 0), "cm"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, color = "black", vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.background = element_rect(color = "transparent"),
    plot.background = element_rect(color = "transparent"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    name = "Date",
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    breaks = seq.Date(ymd("2019-12-01"), ymd("2022-03-31"), by = "3 months"),
    limits = c(as.Date("2019-12-01"), as.Date("2022-03-31")),
    minor_breaks = seq.Date(ymd("2019-12-01"), ymd("2022-03-31"), by = "1 month"),
    expand = c(0.025, 0.025)
  )
```

```{r save-plot, eval=FALSE}
